component.name: Voxa
component.summary: Your personal voice assistant: dictation and local AI

description.p: Voxa records from your microphone, transcribes speech locally with Faster Whisper, sends prompts to a local Ollama model, and reads responses aloud with a natural neural voice and an offline eSpeak NG fallback. Wake it by name, talk freely, and it answers in its own voice.
The interface follows the system GTK and libadwaita theme, supports Wayland and X11, and uses PipeWire or PulseAudio through GStreamer.

screenshot.caption: The Voxa assistant: ACTIVE and OFFLINE controls, a local model picker, and a compact task list

description.p: Voxa gets a face and learns to act. This release adds photoreal characters, hands-free actions and a much faster, more natural conversation.

ul.li: 22 photoreal characters from 11 cultures, each with its own voice, chosen from a portrait button on the main screen.
Facial Quality switch: Low (still portrait), Medium (pre-rendered lip movement) and High (neural face; needs a graphics card and a separately installed face server).
Voxa starts speaking while the answer is still being written, with lip movement timed to the words.
Voice actions: open and close apps, play music and video directly (no ads), media controls, timers and reminders, routines, web browsing in Voxa's own browser.
"Get me the cheapest ticket to Hawaii": flights, hotels, rental cars, cars for sale and products open as a real search, cheapest first, from your current location.
Directions and "where is the nearest…" open in Google Maps.
Web search for questions about named things and anything current, with the source shown under the answer.
PAUSE button and "Voxa, pause": Voxa ignores everything until you say "Voxa" again.
Echo cancellation so Voxa does not hear its own voice; mis-heard wake words and background noise are no longer turned into actions.
Ask for an answer "in German" (or 11 other languages) and Voxa replies in that language with a matching voice.
Strata joins Ollama and llama.cpp as a model backend; models are listed automatically when the server is ready; suggestions leave room for the High face.
Fixes: the window no longer freezes its own status updates, the ACTIVE button always responds, "Ready" and "Listening" always reflect what Voxa is really doing.

description.p: Voxa is the successor of Voice2Text AI: this release declares the rename from io.github.crhy.voice2textai so the Spaced Linux Flatpak update repository can end-of-life the older app and rebase its installed users onto Voxa. Existing Voice2Text AI settings, transcriptions and backups are carried over to Voxa during the migration; nothing else changes.

Voxa now manages a local AI server only when it needs one: it reuses a server that is already running, starts one on a loopback address when needed, reports its health (starting, ready, unavailable, failed), keeps a server log for troubleshooting, and only ever stops a server it started itself. Server changes never block the interface.

VoxaTest is now a separate desktop application that can run beside Voxa, streams progress live, can be stopped at any time without losing results, and writes JSON, text and a Git-friendly failure report. Long runs of hundreds of spoken tests work unattended: whole replies are captured before the next prompt, failures of a single case never stop the run, and reports are updated after every case.
Setting VOXA_SIMULATE_ACTIONS=1 makes Voxa describe app, email and document actions without actually opening them, for automated testing.
Voxa now has an assistant-focused interface with reliable ACTIVE and OFFLINE state handling, selectable local Ollama or llama.cpp backends, and selectable animated characters.

Voice and text requests can open applications, draft email and LibreOffice documents, and use optional web search for current information. Follow-up listening and clearer model, microphone, and server status make conversations more dependable.

The new VoxaTest command provides an end-to-end voice harness with installed test cases, backend-aware configuration, grading, and reports. Packaging and release validation now cover both Voxa and VoxaTest.

Microphone selection now excludes monitor (loopback) sources, so a picked or previously saved microphone can no longer resolve to a PipeWire or PulseAudio monitor that would record the machine's own playback instead of your voice. If a saved profile still references a monitor, capturing starts with a clear error instead of silent audio.

Voxa, the personal voice assistant, is now published from its own repository. Say "voxa" to start a conversation, ask away, and get spoken answers from your local Ollama model with a natural neural voice and an offline eSpeak NG fallback.

Dictation stays on-device: Faster Whisper transcribes locally with adaptive segmentation, model suggestions are sized to your detected GPU, and Ollama installs and model management run from inside the app.

Settings live in ~/.config/voxa, and voxa-backup archives them — encrypted, integrity-checked, with selective restore. The default wake word for conversation mode is "voxa" (change it in Preferences → Conversation if you prefer something else).
